newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Thirteen killed in Bangladesh bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Thirteen killed in Bangladesh bus crash.

text.p: At least 13 people were killed and 50 others injured on Sunday when an overcrowded bus skidded off the road into marshland near the town of Manikganj, 42 miles (70 km) from Dhaka, police said.
Rescue workers retreived eight bodies from inside the bus. Five others died on their way to hospital.
With 20 of the wounded in critical condition, the death toll was expected to rise.
